_readme: Music beds (Stable Audio 2.5, $0.20 per track, .wav) and sound effects (ElevenLabs SFX v2, $0.002/s, .mp3). Copy to ai/audio.json, then: node ../../tools/fal/audio.mjs --project . --dry. Outputs: ai/audio/<id>.wav|mp3.
